zh.title: 中華航空與長榮航空航班再度飛越俄羅斯空域
zh.summary: 中華航空CI75飛越俄羅斯空域，長榮航空也有歐臺航班經過
body: 中華航空CI75航班於2026年10月25日晚間由空中巴士A350-900執飛，追蹤資料顯示，該航班前往Rome-Fiumicino（FCO）時沿北向航路飛越俄羅斯空域。返程飛往Taipei-Taoyuan（TPE）的航班也沿相同航路飛行。
AeroTime報導，包含長榮航空在內的其他臺灣航空公司，之後也有執飛經俄羅斯空域往返歐洲與臺灣的航班。報導指出，臺灣航空公司已超過四年未使用俄羅斯空域；此前避開該空域的政策看來是自願採行，而非基於官方禁令。

en.title: China Airlines and EVA Air flights resume Russian overflights
en.summary: China Airlines and EVA Air operate Europe–Taiwan flights through Russian airspace.
body: China Airlines flight CI75, operated by an Airbus A350-900, was tracked on a northerly route over Russian airspace on the evening of October 25, 2026, while traveling to Rome-Fiumicino (FCO). Its return flight to Taipei-Taoyuan (TPE) followed the same route.

AeroTime also reported that other Taiwanese carriers, including EVA Air, have since operated flights between Europe and Taiwan through Russian airspace. Taiwanese carriers had avoided Russian airspace for more than four years. The report said the policy appeared voluntary rather than based on an official ban.
